facts.title: Yukimiya balance
facts.text: Laboba cooldown 30s → 40s; Street Sweep 30s → 45s; Gyro Shot −15%; Street Dribbling cooldown 23s → 40s, distance −15%; Goal in Time −50%.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Original map and quality of life
history.text: Original map revamped; Sae secret awakening and MVP previews added. Yukimiya restored to Mythic and Gyro Shot returned to B.

history.title: Mobile controls and fixes
history.text: Movable mobile buttons and new loading screen; shot and steal-cutscene bug fixes. King moved to Legendary; Yukimiya temporarily moved to Legendary before the May 23 reversal.

history.title: Yukimiya cooldown patch
history.text: Yukimiya cooldown changes reported for new servers; Lethal Touch set to 60s at the time.

history.title: Yukimiya and Hiori release
history.text: Yukimiya and Hiori styles and flows announced.
